answers.q5_changes: None. The agency uses the vendor product as sold.
answers.q6_description: CaseQueue scores a benefit application and places it in a review queue. It is a vendor product hosted in the vendor cloud. An eligibility supervisor decides whether the file moves forward. Fictional system.
answers.q7_purpose: Eligibility staff now pull the oldest file first. The score proposes an order so incomplete files wait for documents and complete files reach a supervisor. Staff still decide eligibility. Fictional purpose.
answers.q8_how: The score orders benefit files. A supervisor decides each one.
answers.q14_sources: Benefit applications held by the eligibility unit.
answers.q20_harm: A wrong score could delay a complete application or rush an incomplete one. The applicant bears the wait. The eligibility supervisor can change the queue before a decision.
